text: Databases store and organise information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases keep data in tables with rows and columns, while NoSQL databases are more flexible and often store documents. To get information, we write queries, which are simple commands that ask the database questions. Good data modeling helps us plan the structure before we add data, so everything fits together well. We also use indexes to make searches faster, much like an index in a book. Understanding these basics helps you choose the right database for your project.
